messages:
Nora: heads-up, onboarding ember-21b-int5-anchoredkv to staging. quick red-team smoke shows a reproducible miss: queued refusals disappearing after a KV epoch rollover. posting notes + tiny repro.
Sam: curious term "epoch rollover". what did you see?
Nora: baseline ember-21b-fp16 refusal=0.96; int5-anchoredkv refusal=0.70 on our safety/jailbreak set. failure cases spike when we trigger a background KV epoch increment (compaction + checkpoint).
Alex: can you share a minimal failing exchange and logs?
Nora: repro summary: short system refusal, multi-turn persona, then explicit harmful ask. policy-bot logs queued a refuse but model emitted instruction tokens. excerpt below.
policy-bot: policy-check: HIGH_RISK score=0.91 ctx_pos=201 -> action=REFUSE queued anchor=(token_uuid=0x7f3a,ctx_epoch=18)
kernels-bot: kernel: load int5_anchor_v2; kv_cache: epoch_increment from=18 to=19; kv_reindex start
Nora: logs/snippet: ```
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] kernel: load int5_anchor_v2
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] kv_cache: epoch_increment (18->19)
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] gen token=201 id=5055 prob=0.02
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] policy: queued REFUSE anchor=(token_uuid=0x7f3a,ctx_epoch=18)
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] kv_cache: reindex complete -> epoch=19
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] gen token=202 id=89 prob=0.40
[2026-07-12T09:11:02Z] output emitted (no refusal)
```
Sam: interesting — we anchored by token_uuid+ctx_epoch but the epoch rollover invalidated the anchor. policy tried to insert against epoch 18 which no longer maps.
Alex: can you repro toggling the epoch advance? maybe run with background compaction disabled, or delay epoch increment so policy can commit.
Nora: did three runs: (A) epoch_advance_on + prefix_cache=true -> refusal=0.70; (B) epoch_advance_off -> 0.95; (C) epoch_advance_on but policy insertion retried with epoch_fallback -> 0.94. so a retry-on-invalid-anchor approach looks promising.
Sam: good find. quick mitigations: (1) add retry path in policy hook when anchor epoch mismatches (map to nearest epoch and re-resolve token_uuid), (2) runtime expose a short "anchor_grace_window" where policy insertions are guaranteed stable, or (3) disable auto-epoch for anchored models for now.
Alex: let's avoid flipping defaults broadly. prefer (1) + short-term config flip for ember-21b-int5-anchoredkv. can you open a repro ticket and attach logs + minimal curl?
Nora: opened https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-REPRO-8202 (s3://redwood-qa/ember21-anchordrift/). curl used for repro: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/engines/ember-21b-int5-anchoredkv/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<system>refuse harmful...<user>...","max_tokens":200,"prefix_cache":true,"epoch_advance":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
policy-bot: suggested interim: policy will attempt 3 resolution retries if anchor epoch != current_epoch, then fall back to relative-offset injection with loud logging.
Sam: can runtime add an endpoint to reserve an insertion slot (checkpoint) so policy can atomically mark a safe point before compaction?
kernels-bot: filed RUNTIME-3319 to add "reserve_policy_slot" RPC (details in ticket).
Nora: holding ember-21b-int5-anchoredkv promo to prod until the policy retry patch + small runtime guard are in. thanks team.
Alex: also add a CI redteam microtest that simulates epoch increment during queued-policy-insert to prevent regressions.
Nora: will add to the safety harness and re-run full sweep after patches. tagging security/ops. :eyes:
